mentions.name: Solana Wallet Profit Dashboard
mentions.description: This dashboard tracks profit across a set of Solana blockchain wallets. It is being polished for visualization, with planned additions including a simple overview of the most recent profitable wallets to spot new trading "metas" to profit on. The project is currently private and may or may not become open source.
